messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Missing data Multiple Imputation and DIF
parts:
Incomplete observations are not an issue for full-information estimators, which is what mirt uses throughout. Hence, there should be no great need for imputation of incomplete observations, and likelihood ratio tests for DIF would also be unaffected.

Phil
